description: The polar family: a radar chart with one axis per attribute and a polygon per series, the axis pinned through yAxis min and max, series hidden through visible or a legend click; radial-column stacks bars around a circle, nightingale gives every slice the same angle and lets the radius carry the value, and radial-bar draws one ring per category against a shared scale. Every one takes the categories and series a bar chart takes. Free, in @svgrid/grid.

faq.question: How do I pin the radar axis?
faq.answer: Set yAxis min and max on the spec, for instance 0 and 100 for scores, so a series that scores low everywhere does not stretch to the rim.

faq.question: What is the difference between a radial column and a nightingale?
faq.answer: Both put the categories around a circle. A radial column varies the bar length and keeps the angle; a nightingale keeps every slice the same angle and varies the radius, so the area grows with the square of the value.

faq.question: How do I hide a series?
faq.answer: Set visible: false on it, or click its legend item; a double-click isolates one series.
